verdict_text: NO — the merge arithmetic (scale = alpha/r = 2, `B @ A` untransposed since `fan_in_fan_out = false`, accumulated in float32 and cast back to float16) and the four required checks are all correct, but the artifact does not implement the output requirement itself: clause 4 (shard files, `model.safetensors.index.json` with a complete `weight_map`, and the 512 MiB per-shard limit with oversized tensors alone in their own shard) is entirely delegated to an unshown `_ckpt.save_sharded_safetensors`, as is checkpoint loading via `_ckpt.load_checkpoint`. Nothing in the submitted script writes an index, enforces the byte budget, or handles the two 206 MB embedding tensors, so conformance to clause 4 cannot be established from the artifact. It is also outside the stated form of the deliverable — a standalone script using only PyTorch and `safetensors` — since it depends on a local module that is not part of it.
